verdicts.conditionQuote: Clients batch events and send them every 10 seconds, or sooner when the app goes to the background.
verdicts.claimQuote: Client SDKs in the web and mobile apps send events to a collector service over HTTPS.
verdicts.note: Batching delay is a latency limit on delivery; arguably just elaboration.

verdicts.claimQuote: Each event carries an event name, a timestamp, an anonymous device id and, for signed-in users, an account id.
verdicts.note: Without the qualifier every event would seem to carry an account id.

verdicts.conditionQuote: The enrichment step uses the user service.
verdicts.claimQuote: An enrichment step consumes the topic and adds account attributes, such as plan tier and region.
verdicts.note: A dependency of enrichment (matters with u15's load concern); could also be read as plain elaboration.

verdicts.conditionQuote: If an account cannot be found, the event is passed on without account attributes.
verdicts.claimQuote: adds account attributes, such as plan tier and region
verdicts.note: u10 is false for events whose account is not found.

verdicts.conditionQuote: written to the warehouse in hourly batches
verdicts.claimQuote: events reach the warehouse in real time, so launch dashboards stay current
verdicts.note: Hourly batches contradict 'real time'; with launch reviews within 2 hours (u20) dashboards may lag up to an hour.

verdicts.conditionQuote: enrichment should avoid adding much traffic to it
verdicts.claimQuote: The enrichment step uses the user service.
verdicts.note: Design constraint on enrichment; no claim becomes false.

verdicts.conditionQuote: Every event type must be registered before clients can send it.
verdicts.claimQuote: Client SDKs in the web and mobile apps send events to a collector service
verdicts.note: Prerequisite; u8 already says unregistered events are rejected.

verdicts.conditionQuote: a breaking change requires a new version rather than an edit to the existing one
verdicts.note: A rule on schema change; could be read as elaboration (not_a_condition).

verdicts.conditionQuote: How long the aggregated tables are kept is TBD.
verdicts.claimQuote: only aggregated tables are kept longer
verdicts.note: Open gap on retention; u22 stays true.

verdicts.conditionQuote: Warehouse raw events | Data team | 90 days
verdicts.claimQuote: Raw events will be kept for 30 days and then deleted
verdicts.note: Table contradicts the 30-day retention; one of the two is wrong, so u22 cannot be stated alone.

verdicts.conditionQuote: once the mobile SDK is ready; no date has been set for it
verdicts.claimQuote: Client SDKs in the web and mobile apps send events to a collector service over HTTPS.
verdicts.note: Mobile sending is conditional and unscheduled, so u5's 'web and mobile' is misleading for the near term.

verdicts.conditionQuote: The cost of running the pipeline has not been estimated yet.
verdicts.claimQuote: We ask for approval to start phase 1
verdicts.note: Unknown-cost caveat on the approval ask; could also attach to u37's effort estimate.

additional.conditionQuote: Phase 1 covers the web app's sign-up and checkout events.
additional.claimQuote: which features paying customers use in their first month
additional.note: Phase 1 scope may not answer the feature-usage question.

additional.conditionQuote: What happens to events the collector rejects: are they dropped, or kept somewhere for debugging?
additional.claimQuote: rejects events that do not match a registered schema
